answer_1.quote: In this paper, we examine the bias of GPT-2 text generation against AAVE features.
answer_1.outputs: generated text segments in AAVE and SAE

answer_2.quote: The generated text is compared to its corresponding original second segment by BLEU, ROUGE, and sentiment scores.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation using AMT to assess the quality of the text generated by GPT-2.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose which one of the two generated phrases better fits the context of the respective first segment, which one has better quality, and which one is most likely machine-generated.
